subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Shoulder Dystocia, McRoberts and Prolonged Labour

steps.tx: Impaction of the anterior shoulder behind the pubic symphysis after head delivery is **shoulder dystocia**. The head retracts against the perineum in the turtle sign. It is unpredictable in most cases, so drills matter more than prediction. It complicates under one percent of vaginal births, and half occur in babies under 4 kilograms.
steps.say: Shoulder dystocia impacts the anterior shoulder and drills matter more than prediction.

vis.caption: Shoulder dystocia pathophysiology showing anterior shoulder impaction behind the pubic symphysis and McRoberts maneuver. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: Hyperflexing the mothers thighs onto her abdomen, flattening the sacrum, is the **McRoberts manoeuvre**. Combined with suprapubic pressure it frees half to two thirds of cases. It is always the first manoeuvre, with help summoned simultaneously. Suprapubic pressure is applied downward and lateral, never fundal pressure, which wedges the shoulder tighter.
steps.say: McRoberts hyperflexes thighs and frees most shoulder dystocia with suprapubic pressure.

steps.tx: Internal rotational manoeuvres and delivery of the posterior arm follow failed McRoberts in the **HELPERR sequence**. Help, evaluate episiotomy, legs, pressure, enter, extract, roll organises the drill. Each step has thirty seconds before moving on. Thirty seconds per manoeuvre keeps the drill moving; most babies deliver within five minutes of the head.
steps.say: The HELPERR sequence organises shoulder dystocia steps after McRoberts fails.

steps.tx: Brachial plexus stretch injury, usually Erb palsy, is the feared fetal complication, termed **plexus injury**. Most recover within months, a minority persist. Documentation of manoeuvres and timings protects baby follow up and staff equally. Erb palsy affects C5 and C6, giving the waiter tip arm posture most parents first notice.
steps.say: Plexus injury stretches the brachial plexus and most Erb palsies recover in months.

steps.tx: Last resort measures include cleidotomy, symphysiotomy and the Zavanelli manoeuvre under **salvage procedures**. Symphysiotomy retains a real role where caesarean is unavailable or unsafe. These are rehearsed conceptually even where rarely used. Zavanelli replaces the head under anaesthesia and delivers by caesarean, reported in small series with good outcomes when quick.
steps.say: Salvage procedures include symphysiotomy, which retains a role where caesarean is unsafe.

steps.tx: Labour exceeding expected duration by stage defines **prolonged labour** variably. First stage prolongation splits into latent and active problems with different responses. Second stage limits differ for first and subsequent births and epidural use. Active first stage slower than one centimetre per two hours after 6 centimetres is the modern arrest definition many units use.
steps.say: Prolonged labour definitions split latent and active problems with different responses.

steps.tx: Inadequate contractions are the commonest correctable cause of slow labour, treated by **oxytocin augmentation**. Amniotomy precedes it and progress is reassessed in four hours. Hyperstimulation is watched for with continuous monitoring. Four to five strong contractions in ten minutes is the target; more is hyperstimulation and the infusion is halved or stopped.
steps.say: Oxytocin augmentation corrects inadequate contractions after amniotomy with four hour review.

vis.caption: Posterior pituitary oxytocin synthesis and molecular receptor cascade stimulating myometrial contractions. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: The three Ps framework sorts slow labour into powers, passenger and passage causes, taught as **powers passenger passage**. Each demands different correction, from oxytocin to rotation to caesarean. Systematic sorting prevents reflex caesareans for fixable powers problems. A deflexed head is a passenger problem that oxytocin cannot fix, which is why examination precedes augmentation.
steps.say: Powers, passenger and passage sorting prevents reflex caesareans for fixable contraction problems.

steps.tx: After dystocia, debriefing parents and staff plus physiotherapy referral completes care, termed **post event care**. Shoulder dystocia recurs in about one in ten next deliveries. The next birth plan is documented before discharge. Recurrence risk of about 10 percent earns a consultant led plan, often offering elective caesarean.
steps.say: Post event care debriefs dystocia and documents the next birth plan before discharge.
